n: Learn Like a Computer (Canada Learning Code)
t: A 30-minute lesson with two games that model how computers learn from examples.
steps: Find Learn Like a Computer on the Canada Learning Code site.
Click Download Lesson, which opens a Google Doc.
Find an object in the classroom to use in Hot or Cold.
Draw a number on a board or paper.
Queue the Amazon video if you plan to show it.
Teach the picnic game, then Hot or Cold, then the reflection.
